title: Requirement excluded only by an inequality
description: requirements.txt declares a `!=` specifier that leaves every other version acceptable. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `!=` specifier that leaves every other version acceptable.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `!=` specifier that leaves every other version acceptable.
limitation: It matches a `!=` specifier that leaves every other version acceptable in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
